Installation

Choose how you want to install Sorter — a pre-built OS image for Orange Pi 5, a one-command installer for generic Linux, or a manual step-by-step setup.

SorterOS

A pre-built OS image for the Orange Pi 5. Flash, configure WiFi, plug in — no install steps required.

Linux (generic)

One-command installer for Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04, or Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm on any machine.

By hand

The manual step-by-step sequence — for unsupported platforms or when you want full control.
